rationale: The critical path runs through the ALU. funct3==000 currently infers TWO 32-bit carry chains, (a - alu_b) and (a + alu_b), selected by a mux, so the adder area and the mux delay are both on the path. Standard fix: one adder with a conditionally inverted B input and carry-in, a - b == a + ~b + 1.
